what_is_closed: For fixed -1<beta<0 and zeta != 0, the generic Eq. (123) factor F=(zeta+R)/(1-beta), R^2=zeta^2+1-beta^2, cannot vanish because R=-zeta would contradict 1-beta^2>0. The only speed-factor zero in Re(zeta)>=0 is zeta=-beta, treated by the corrected ODE-consistent Jordan chart.

At glancing R=0, Eq. (123) has the positive limit (1-beta^2)^5/[256*abs(beta)^20*(1-beta)^16]. At high frequency its determinant tends to 2^8/[abs(beta)^20*(1-beta)^6]; both limits were compared with source-matrix screens.

The complex Jordan divided-difference chart was screened on 20 paths and converges to the corrected exact Jordan operator. The high-frequency transfer screen covers 45 points and supports, but does not prove, ||T_infinity||_2=1-beta.
At zeta radii down to 1e-10, 60 complex approaches show directionally stable transfer norms for beta=[-0.1, -0.5, -0.9]; this is numerical endpoint evidence, not an exact zeta=0 matrix limit.

An exploratory high-frequency screen covers 120 points across 12 fixed beta values and 5 complex directions; the maximum norm error at radius 100000 is 1.15e-09. The grid and tolerance followed a preliminary diagnostic preview, so this is not preregistered or independent validation; it remains finite-grid evidence, not an exact limit or continuous beta bound.

The linked high-frequency endpoint artifact constructs T_infinity(beta)=W_infinity*C_infinity^-1 from the exact leading normalized modes. Its analytic determinant limit is nonzero for every fixed -1<beta<0; the norm identity remains numerical only.
what_remains_open: The zeta->0 transfer extension and a rigorous transfer-operator bound over all finite frequencies for each fixed beta remain unproved. The numerical identity ||T_infinity||_2=1-beta also lacks a symbolic norm proof.
No common Kreiss constant over the full -1<beta<0 family is claimed; the separate beta->-1 no-uniform result remains controlling.
Full first-order variable-coefficient GH boundary evolution, tangential/corner treatment, dimensional-observable mapping, and the Core curved 3+1 parent remain open.
